form.label: L2T - Summary
form.description: Comprehensive overview of log2timeline forensic data with security insights and investigation starting points

search.query: index=host sourcetype=l2t* | eval host = upper(host) | search host=$hostFilter$ | stats count by sourcetype, host, source

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | eval host = upper(host) | search host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id IN (4624, 4625, 4648, 4720, 4722, 4724, 4726, 4732, 4733) | stats count by event_id, host
index=host sourcetype=l2t* | eval host=upper(host) | stats count by host | sort -count

index=host sourcetype=l2t* | eval host = upper(host) | search host=$hostFilter$ | stats earliest(_time) as start_time, latest(_time) as end_time | eval timespan_days = round((end_time - start_time) / 86400, 1) | table timespan_days

| stats sum(count) as count by sourcetype | eval artifact_description=case( sourcetype="l2t:winevtx", "Event Logs", sourcetype="l2t:registry", "Registry", sourcetype="l2t:NTFS", "NTFS ($MFT)", sourcetype="l2t:File", "File System", sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache", "App Execution", sourcetype="l2t:PE", "Executables", sourcetype="l2t:Network", "Network", sourcetype="l2t:Chrome", "Chrome Browser", sourcetype="l2t:Google", "Google Services", true(), sourcetype ) | sort -count

index=host sourcetype=l2t* | eval host = upper(host) | search host=$hostFilter$ | eval artifact_category=case( sourcetype="l2t:winevtx", "Event Logs", sourcetype="l2t:registry", "Registry", sourcetype="l2t:NTFS" OR sourcetype="l2t:File", "File System", sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache", "Program Execution", sourcetype="l2t:PE", "Executable Analysis", sourcetype="l2t:Network", "Network Activity", sourcetype="l2t:Chrome" OR sourcetype="l2t:Google", "Browser Activity", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=4h count by artifact_category

| eval event_description=case( event_id="4624", "Successful Logons", event_id="4625", "Failed Logons", event_id="4648", "Explicit Credential Use", event_id="4720", "User Account Created", event_id="4722", "User Account Enabled", event_id="4724", "Password Reset Attempt", event_id="4726", "User Account Deleted", event_id="4732", "Member Added to Security Group", event_id="4733", "Member Removed from Security Group", true(), "Event ID " + event_id ) | eval risk_level=case( event_id IN ("4625", "4648", "4720", "4724", "4726"), "High", event_id IN ("4722", "4732", "4733"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | stats sum(count) as total_events, values(host) as affected_hosts by event_description, event_id, risk_level | sort risk_level, -total_events

| makeresults | eval priorities=split("Failed Logon Events (4625),Privilege Escalation,New User Accounts,Suspicious File Execution,Network Connections,Registry Persistence,Browser Downloads,Deleted Files", ",") | mvexpand priorities | eval dashboard=case( match(priorities, "Logon"), "L2T-Enhanced-Logon-Analysis", match(priorities, "User"), "L2T-WinEVTX", match(priorities, "File"), "L2T-NTFS-Files", match(priorities, "Network"), "L2T-Network", match(priorities, "Registry"), "L2T-Registry", match(priorities, "Browser"), "L2T-Chrome-Browser-Forensics", match(priorities, "Deleted"), "L2T-NTFS-Files", true(), "L2T-WinEVTX" ) | eval description=case( match(priorities, "Failed Logon"), "Check for brute force attacks and unauthorized access attempts", match(priorities, "Privilege"), "Look for unusual elevation and admin activity", match(priorities, "User"), "Investigate account creation and management activities", match(priorities, "File"), "Analyze suspicious program execution and file operations", match(priorities, "Network"), "Review network connections and data exfiltration", match(priorities, "Registry"), "Examine persistence mechanisms and configuration changes", match(priorities, "Browser"), "Investigate web activity and potential malicious downloads", match(priorities, "Deleted"), "Analyze file deletion patterns and data destruction", true(), "General investigation area" ) | table priorities, description, dashboard | rename priorities as "Investigation Area", description as "Focus", dashboard as "Recommended Dashboard"
| stats sum(count) as total_events by host | sort -total_events | head 10

| eval artifact_type=case( sourcetype="l2t:winevtx", "Event Logs", sourcetype="l2t:registry", "Registry", sourcetype="l2t:NTFS" OR sourcetype="l2t:File", "File System", sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache", "App Execution", sourcetype="l2t:PE", "Executables", sourcetype="l2t:Network", "Network", sourcetype="l2t:Chrome" OR sourcetype="l2t:Google", "Browser", true(), "Other" ) | stats dc(host) as host_count by artifact_type | sort -host_count

| eval artifact_description=case( sourcetype="l2t:winevtx", "Windows Event Logs - Security, System, Application events for user activity and system changes", sourcetype="l2t:registry", "Windows Registry - Configuration changes, persistence mechanisms, user preferences", sourcetype="l2t:NTFS", "NTFS Master File Table - File creation, modification, deletion, and access patterns", sourcetype="l2t:File", "File System Activity - General file operations and metadata changes", sourcetype="l2t:AppCompatCache", "Application Compatibility Cache - Program execution history and ShimCache analysis", sourcetype="l2t:PE", "Portable Executable Files - Malware analysis, import/export functions, security assessment", sourcetype="l2t:Network", "Network Connections - WiFi history, network drives, connection artifacts", sourcetype="l2t:Chrome", "Chrome Browser Activity - Web history, downloads, cookies, user behavior", sourcetype="l2t:Google", "Google Services - Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Search activity and synchronization", true(), "Other forensic artifacts and data sources" ) | stats sum(count) as events, dc(host) as hosts, dc(source) as sources by sourcetype, artifact_description | sort -events | rename sourcetype as "Source Type", artifact_description as "Description", events as "Events", hosts as "Hosts", sources as "Files"

| eval file_category=case( match(source, "(?i)\.evtx$"), "Event Log Files", match(source, "(?i)(SYSTEM|SOFTWARE|SAM|SECURITY|NTUSER)"), "Registry Hives", match(source, "(?i)\\\$MFT"), "NTFS Master File Table", match(source, "(?i)(History|Cookies|Cache)"), "Browser Artifacts", match(source, "(?i)network"), "Network Artifacts", true(), "Other Evidence" ) | stats sum(count) as events, dc(host) as hosts, values(sourcetype) as artifact_types by source, file_category | sort file_category, -events | head 20 | rename source as "Evidence File", file_category as "Category", events as "Events", hosts as "Hosts", artifact_types as "Artifact Types"

format.colorPalette: {"Event Log Files":#3498db,"Registry Hives":#e74c3c,"NTFS Master File Table":#2ecc71,"Browser Artifacts":#f39c12,"Network Artifacts":#9b59b6,"Other Evidence":#95a5a6}
